name: 08701 · Lakewood, NJ
findings: ZIP 08701 (Lakewood) has 1,150 nonprofit organizations. 158 of them (14%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 122 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08701 (Lakewood) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 08701 (Lakewood) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 22% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?
